name: adagio-agent-controller
description: VS Code extension that connects Copilot to a Windows VM agent for automated executable testing

commands.title: Adagio Agent: Run Executable in VM
Adagio Agent: Run Installer And Collect Artifacts
Adagio Agent: Run And Collect Artifacts
Adagio Agent: Run Installer And Assert
Adagio Agent: Copy File to Target
Adagio Agent: Wait For Process Exit

adagioAgent.vmAgentUrl.description: Base URL of the VM agent (prefer https://127.0.0.1:5443/api/v1)

adagioAgent.vmAgentApiKey.description: API key sent as X-API-Key to authenticate with the machine agent

languageModelTools.name: adagioAgent_runExecutable
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Start an executable inside the Windows VM and return its process ID.

command.description: Full path to the executable on the VM, e.g. C:\Apps\MyApp.exe

arguments.description: Optional command-line arguments to pass to the executable

workingDirectory.description: Optional working directory for the process

languageModelTools.name: adagioAgent_runInstallerAndCollectArtifacts
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Launch an installer process and return combined exit status, optional log tail, and recent MSI event log entries.

command.description: Full path to the installer executable on the target machine

workingDirectory.description: Optional working directory for the installer

timeoutMilliseconds.description: How long to wait for the installer to exit before collecting artifacts

logPath.description: Optional installer log path to tail

tailLines.description: Number of lines to include from the end of the installer log

includeMsiEvents.description: Whether to include recent MSI installer event log entries

eventEntryCount.description: Maximum number of MSI event log entries to include

languageModelTools.name: adagioAgent_runAndCollectArtifacts
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Start a process and return combined exit status, optional log tail, and optional event log entries.

command.description: Full path to the executable on the target machine

timeoutMilliseconds.description: How long to wait for the process to exit before collecting artifacts

tailLines.description: Number of lines to include from the end of the log

includeMsiEvents.description: Whether to include recent MsiInstaller event log entries on Windows

eventEntryCount.description: Maximum number of event log entries to include

languageModelTools.name: adagioAgent_runInstallerAndAssert
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Launch an installer, collect diagnostics, and evaluate expected exit/log/path assertions.

command.description: Full path to the installer executable on the target machine

workingDirectory.description: Optional working directory for the installer

timeoutMilliseconds.description: How long to wait for installer exit before evaluating assertions

tailLines.description: Number of lines to include from the log tail

includeMsiEvents.description: Whether to include recent MSI installer event log entries

eventEntryCount.description: Maximum number of MSI event log entries to include

expectedPath.description: Optional expected file or directory path to verify

expectedPathMustBeDirectory.description: When true, expectedPath must be a directory

logMustContainText.description: Optional expected text that must be present in logPath

logContainsIgnoreCase.description: When true, log text match ignores case

languageModelTools.name: adagioAgent_runAndAssert
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Start a process, collect diagnostics, and evaluate expected exit/log/path assertions.

command.description: Full path to the executable on the target machine

timeoutMilliseconds.description: How long to wait for process exit before evaluating assertions

tailLines.description: Number of lines to include from log tail

includeMsiEvents.description: Whether to include recent MsiInstaller event log entries on Windows

eventEntryCount.description: Maximum number of event log entries to include

expectedPath.description: Optional expected file or directory path to verify

expectedPathMustBeDirectory.description: When true, expectedPath must be a directory

logMustContainText.description: Optional expected text that must be present in logPath

logContainsIgnoreCase.description: When true, log text match ignores case

languageModelTools.name: adagioAgent_getUiTree
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Return the UI element hierarchy of the application window so Copilot can reason about which buttons or controls exist.

languageModelTools.name: adagioAgent_listDirectory
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List files and directories under a target path on the machine.

languageModelTools.name: adagioAgent_fileExists
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Check whether a file or directory exists at a target path.

path.description: File or directory path to check

languageModelTools.name: adagioAgent_assertProcessExited
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Assert that a tracked process exits, optionally with a specific exit code.

timeoutMilliseconds.description: Maximum time to wait for process exit

languageModelTools.name: adagioAgent_assertPathExists
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Assert that a file or directory path exists on the target machine.

mustBeDirectory.description: When true, assertion requires the path to be a directory

languageModelTools.name: adagioAgent_assertLogContains
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Assert that a text log file contains an expected text fragment.

path.description: Text log file path to inspect

containsText.description: Expected text to find in the log content

ignoreCase.description: When true, performs case-insensitive text matching

languageModelTools.name: adagioAgent_getScreenshot
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Capture a screenshot of the application window and return it as a base64-encoded PNG.

languageModelTools.name: adagioAgent_clickElement
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Click a UI element in the application window by its element ID from the UI tree.

elementId.description: Element ID from the UI tree

languageModelTools.name: adagioAgent_typeText
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Type text into a UI element in the application window.

elementId.description: Element ID from the UI tree

text.description: Text to type into the element

languageModelTools.name: adagioAgent_copyFile
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Copy a local file to the machine-agent target system.

localFilePath.description: Absolute local path to the source file

destinationPath.description: Absolute destination path on the target machine

overwriteIfExists.description: When true, overwrite an existing destination file

languageModelTools.name: adagioAgent_getProcessStatus
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get current state, timestamps, and optional exit code for a tracked process.

languageModelTools.name: adagioAgent_waitForExit
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Wait for a tracked process to exit up to the specified timeout.

languageModelTools.name: adagioAgent_collectInstallArtifacts
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Wait for an installer process and collect diagnostic artifacts such as exit status, log tail, and recent MSI event log entries.

pid.description: Tracked process ID returned by runExecutable

timeoutMilliseconds.description: How long to wait for the process to exit before collecting artifacts

logPath.description: Optional installer log path to tail on the target machine

tailLines.description: Number of lines to include from the tail of the log file

includeMsiEvents.description: Whether to include recent MsiInstaller event log entries

eventEntryCount.description: Maximum number of MsiInstaller event log entries to return

languageModelTools.name: adagioAgent_collectProcessArtifacts
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Wait for a process and collect diagnostic artifacts such as exit status, log tail, and optional Windows event log entries.

pid.description: Tracked process ID returned by runExecutable

timeoutMilliseconds.description: How long to wait for the process to exit before collecting artifacts

logPath.description: Optional log path to tail on the target machine

tailLines.description: Number of lines to include from the tail of the log file

includeMsiEvents.description: Whether to include recent MsiInstaller event log entries

eventEntryCount.description: Maximum number of event log entries to return

languageModelTools.name: adagioAgent_terminateProcess
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Terminate a tracked process on the target machine.

languageModelTools.name: adagioAgent_readTextFile
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read a UTF-8 text file from the target machine.

path.description: Absolute path to a target text file

languageModelTools.name: adagioAgent_tailFile
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read the last N lines of a UTF-8 text file from the target machine.

path.description: Absolute path to a target text file

lines.description: Number of lines from the end of file

languageModelTools.name: adagioAgent_getElementState
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Retrieve the current state snapshot of a UI element.

elementId.description: Element ID from the UI tree

languageModelTools.name: adagioAgent_waitForElement
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Wait until a UI element becomes available or timeout is reached.

elementId.description: Element ID from the UI tree

languageModelTools.name: adagioAgent_setFocus
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Focus a specific UI element in the application window.

elementId.description: Element ID from the UI tree

languageModelTools.name: adagioAgent_sendKeys
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Send keystrokes to the currently focused application window.

languageModelTools.name: adagioAgent_pressHotkey
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Press a key combination like Alt+N or Ctrl+Tab in the application window.

languageModelTools.name: adagioAgent_setCheckbox
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Toggle a checkbox or radio button in the installer UI to a specific checked/unchecked state.

elementId.description: Element ID from the UI tree (e.g. checkbox-eula)

isChecked.description: True to check the element, false to uncheck it

languageModelTools.name: adagioAgent_selectOption
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Select an item in a combo box or list control by visible text label or zero-based index.

elementId.description: Element ID of the combo box or list (from the UI tree)

optionText.description: Visible text of the option to select (case-insensitive)

optionIndex.description: Zero-based index of the option to select (used when optionText is not provided)
